tickets.name: First Points
tickets.note: Hawks roll into Wizards territory, and the first minute is all we care about! It starts with Davis against Okongwu at center court, and our money says Davis gets up there first! This opening could break either way, so we're ready for both! Dybantsa is the first option in that opening set, and he does not pass it up! And if the Hawks flip the script, Okongwu is waiting right there to pounce! Every one of our picks is a way to win the opening bucket, and every one of them cashes!

tickets.name: Open Floor
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for 76ers at Pistons, because the first minute is where the money is! Embiid versus Reed in the circle, and nobody owns that jump ball! Either side can strike first here, and we like the Pistons to make it count! If Reed controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look! Collins is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! Pick your poison, because any of them covers it!
